overall_intent: Refine the independently authored cryobank inspection photograph at creativity 1: a reference-guided fictional researcher recognizes one thawed specimen among frozen neighbors, and her paused hand makes the moment of biomedical unease visible. Search only vessel state, bounded surface moisture and the existing clinical-order/anomaly contrast; compare complete sources with the baseline and leave all optional material unselected when it adds no concrete benefit.

prop_state.reason: The supported rack and one sealed specimen ampoule must remain distinguishable as a contained inspection state.
prop_state.expressive_goal: Make a controlled laboratory object feel newly unreliable through its legible contained state and relation to untouched neighboring samples.
observable_targets: An upright sealed ampoule in a supported rack.
One anomalous thawed sample contrasted with frozen neighboring ampoules.
owner_relations: The rack rests on the counter; ampoules belong to the rack.
The tissue culture and liquid are contained inside the anomalous ampoule; the researcher remains a separate person.
open_scope: Restrained refinement of the container closure and inspection-readiness cues.
Replace or simplify incidental rack staging when it improves the comparison without transferring the anomaly to the person.
prop_state.role_focus: A laboratory specimen vessel in a controlled inspection state: one sealed upright vial has thawed while the adjacent samples remain frosted. Look for observable containment and readiness cues that can sharpen the anomaly in a realistic cryobank photograph.
prop_state.scene_context: A fictional short-haired researcher has stopped at a stainless counter after drawing out a cryobank rack. Her gloved hand pauses above the anomalous sample.

grounds.quote: A still moment of biomedical unease while a fictional researcher notices one thawed specimen among frozen ampoules

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The source is the independent frozen event, not candidate data. The vessel state and tissue ownership can be developed locally; the whole topic and reference remain protected. A proposed damaged or open vessel is not automatically compatible with a currently sealed baseline.

required_constraints: Keep the medical-horror topic and the fictional person guided by the supplied portrait.
Preserve the scoped facial proportions and short dark bob; a suggested specimen property belongs to the specimen or container, never the person.
preserved_choices: The independently authored cryobank-thaw direction remains the comparison baseline at creativity 1.
The reference applies to face and hair only; wardrobe, age and scenario mechanics were not requester prescriptions.

surface_moisture.reason: Bounded droplets and a wet base distinguish the anomalous sample from the dry frozen neighbors in the current independent scene.
surface_moisture.expressive_goal: Use a clearly owned wet-to-dry boundary to make one specimen state conspicuous, without relying on generic glass shine.
observable_targets: Distinct droplets on the anomalous ampoule and a bounded wet footprint at its base.
Dry matte frost on neighboring vials and steel that lets the wet boundary read.
owner_relations: Condensation belongs to the vial surface or the steel beneath its base.
The liquid inside the sealed vial remains separate from outside surface moisture and from the researcher.
open_scope: Local moisture placement, droplet scale and contrast.
Restrained replacement or subtraction of redundant wet cues while preserving a readable sample contrast.
surface_moisture.role_focus: Owned surface moisture on a specimen container and adjacent steel: bounded condensation droplets or a wet footprint on one vial, visibly distinct from dry matte frost on its frozen neighbors. Keep reflection and liquid inside the vessel distinct from surface wetness.
surface_moisture.scene_context: Night cryobank inspection; one transparent thawed ampoule sits in the front row of a frosted rack while a short-haired researcher stops before touching it.

grounds.quote: One transparent thawed ampoule and its wet base stand between visibly frosted neighboring ampoules

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The frozen priority supplies a wet base, frosted neighboring owners and their contrast. Surface moisture is not a thermal measurement and does not prove a breach, chemical hazard or biological activity. Candidate suggestions must be reviewed for these unsupported implications.

concept_tension.reason: The photograph depends on a concrete contrast between ordered cryobank storage and one physically anomalous specimen.
concept_tension.expressive_goal: Make medical control and material uncertainty visible together as restrained biomedical dread, with the human response connected to the sample.
observable_targets: Orderly frozen racks behind one clear thawed sample.
The researcher looks at the anomaly with her hand paused before contact.
owner_relations: Clinical order is carried by the freezer and regular rack; the exception is carried by one specimen.
The researcher attends to that same sample, making the response causally readable.
open_scope: Local arrangement, light and restrained scene clues that clarify this existing contrast.
Simplification of decorative cues that obscure the sample-person relation.
concept_tension.role_focus: Clinical order under pressure from one observable specimen anomaly. An orderly cryobank with frozen stock is interrupted by a single clear thawed sample, while the inspecting researcher pauses before contact; support quiet biomedical dread through this same concrete contrast.
concept_tension.scene_context: Realistic medical-horror photograph with the reference-guided face and short dark bob, a supported vial rack, and no added impossible physics under surreal 0.

grounds.quote: The scene aims for quiet biomedical dread: comparative frost states explain why her inspection stops, while the reachable but untouched ampoule makes her next act uncertain.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This is a search for local expression of the already frozen medical-horror direction. The concept dimension stays locked to requester meaning; this slot grants no permission to substitute a different genre, change the reference person, or invent hidden biological intent.
